name: SessionStart
what: Fires when a session starts or resumes. Can add additionalContext. On source resume or fork (v2.1.251+) the input carries seconds_since_last_response, context_tokens, prompt_cache_likely_expired, estimated_cache_write_usd.
token_use: Only documented hook input with token or cost numbers; use it to watch cache-rebuild cost on resume. additionalContext adds tokens.

name: UserPromptSubmit
what: Fires when a prompt is submitted, before Claude processes it. Can block. Can add additionalContext; cannot rewrite the prompt.
token_use: Observe prompt size; any additionalContext it injects is paid input on every turn it applies to.

name: UserPromptExpansion
what: Fires when a user command expands into a prompt. Can block. Can add additionalContext.
token_use: Observe expansion; additionalContext adds input tokens.

name: PreToolUse
what: Fires before a tool call runs. Can block (exit 2 or permissionDecision deny). Can rewrite arguments via updatedInput and add additionalContext. Docs example rewrites Bash test commands to pipe through grep and head so only failures return.
token_use: Cuts tool output at the source by rewriting the command. Changes what runs, so it is not pure observation.

name: PermissionRequest
what: Fires when a tool call needs a permission decision. Decides via decision.behavior; can set updatedInput inside decision. Exit 2 is ignored.
token_use: No direct token effect; fewer prompts means fewer stalled turns.

name: PermissionDenied
what: Fires when auto mode denies a tool call. No blocking; returns retry:true as advisory to the model.
token_use: Observe denials; advisory retry can cost an extra turn.

name: PostToolUse
what: Fires after a tool call succeeds. Output fields: updatedToolOutput (replaces the tool result), additionalContext (added next to the result), top-level decision block with reason. Exit 2 only shows stderr. Docs do not confirm whether updatedToolOutput covers built-in and MCP tools alike; a separate updatedMCPToolOutput name was not found on the page.
token_use: The documented hook that can trim a tool result before the model reads it. Each byte you keep is what enters context.

name: PostToolUseFailure
what: Fires after a tool call fails. Same blocking rules as PostToolUse; output is additionalContext.
token_use: Observe failures; additionalContext adds tokens. Use to count retry loops.

name: PostToolBatch
what: Fires after a parallel tool batch resolves, before the next model call. Can stop the loop (block) and add additionalContext.
token_use: Good budget guard: observe batch size and stop runaway loops before the next paid call.

name: Notification
what: Fires when Claude Code sends a notification. No output fields.
token_use: None.

name: MessageDisplay
what: Fires when assistant text is displayed. Output displayContent changes display only.
token_use: None on the model side; display only.

name: SubagentStart
what: Fires when a subagent is spawned. Can add additionalContext.
token_use: Count subagent spawns; additionalContext is paid in the subagent context.

name: SubagentStop
what: Fires when a subagent finishes. Can block and add additionalContext. Input includes last_assistant_message (the docs say to use it instead of reading the transcript) and transcript_path.
token_use: Read the subagent's final message without parsing its transcript; no usage counts documented here.

name: Stop
what: Fires when Claude finishes responding. Can block to continue the conversation; can add additionalContext. Input includes last_assistant_message.
token_use: Per-turn hook point for logging turn end; no usage fields documented.

name: StopFailure
what: Fires when a turn ends on an API error. No output except terminalSequence.
token_use: Observe failed turns that still cost retries.

name: PreCompact
what: Fires before context compaction. Can block. Matcher values include manual and auto. Input field names (trigger, custom_instructions) were not confirmed on the page read.
token_use: Observe compaction triggers and log context size before the rewrite. Blocking compaction is not recommended.

name: PostCompact
what: Fires after compaction completes. No output fields. Matcher values manual and auto.
token_use: Observe post-compaction state; pair with PreCompact to measure the size drop.

name: PreModelSwitch
what: Fires before a requested model switch. Can block (decision block cancels) and set permissionDecision.
token_use: Guard against accidental Opus switches; blocks cost nothing.

name: PostModelSwitch
what: Fires after the model changes. Can add additionalContext.
token_use: Log model switches to attribute spend per model.

name: SessionEnd
what: Fires when the session terminates. No output fields.
token_use: Write the final per-session record (pair with statusline or OTEL totals).

name: InstructionsLoaded
what: Fires when CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/*.md is loaded. No output fields.
token_use: Measure always-on instruction size per session.

name: Setup, TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, TeammateIdle, ConfigChange, CwdChanged, DirectoryAdded, FileChanged, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, Elicitation, ElicitationResult
what: Remaining lifecycle events from the hooks lifecycle table. Most only observe. TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, TeammateIdle and ConfigChange can block. WorktreeCreate returns a path. Elicitation and ElicitationResult carry action and content.
token_use: Not directly token-relevant; TeammateIdle and TaskCompleted bound agent-team spend.

name: CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE
what: Percentage (1-100) of the auto-compact window at which auto-compaction triggers. Lower values compact earlier; it cannot raise the threshold. Applies to main conversation and subagents.
token_use: Keeps the context smaller on every turn, at the cost of more summarization and one cache rebuild per compaction.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW
what: Auto-compact window in tokens, 100000 to 1000000. Highest precedence while set; overrides /autocompact, --autocompact and the autoCompactWindow setting. Capped at the model's context window.
token_use: Sets the size at which the conversation is summarized; a smaller window means a smaller re-read on every turn.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS
what: Context size at which idle compaction applies. Default 200000; values below 100000 are raised to 100000.
token_use: Lower it to compact idle sessions earlier, before the cache expires and a full re-read is billed.

name: autoCompactWindow (setting) and modelSettings
what: settings.json key for the auto-compact window, applied to all models; a window saved per model by /autocompact under modelSettings takes precedence in the same file. Accepts 100K to 1M; a bare number 100 to 1000 means thousands.
token_use: Persistent version of CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW; keeps every new session on a smaller window.

name: BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH
what: Maximum characters of Bash output read back into a command result. Default 30000, max 150000. Ignored when the bashOutputMaxChars setting is set.
token_use: Hard cap on Bash result size per call; a lower value cuts input tokens but can hide needed lines.

name: bashOutputMaxChars (setting)
what: Settings-file equivalent of BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH; when set it overrides the env var.
token_use: Same cap as the env var, managed in settings.json.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
what: Token limit for a single file read. Default 25000.
token_use: Caps the size of any one Read result entering context.

name: MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS
what: Named in the request; NOT confirmed on the env-vars page read (excerpt was truncated). Treat as unverified until the full env-vars reference is read.
token_use: Expected to cap MCP tool result size per call if it exists; unverified.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH
what: Maximum characters of each MCP tool description and server instruction sent to the model. Default 4096, or 16384 for a tool loaded through tool search.
token_use: Shrinks the per-session tool-listing overhead from MCP servers.

name: ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH
what: Set to true to enable MCP tool search when a proxy forwards tool_reference blocks. Disabled by default when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at a non-first-party host. MCP tools are deferred by default on the first-party API.
token_use: Keeps MCP tool definitions out of context until a tool is used.

name: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS
what: Fixed thinking budget used when adaptive reasoning is disabled; 0 disables extended thinking on the Anthropic API. Ignored on adaptive-reasoning models (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 always think); use /effort there.
token_use: Thinking is billed as output tokens; a lower budget cuts output cost but can reduce quality on hard tasks.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
what: Maximum output tokens for most requests. Values above the model cap are lowered to it. Higher values reduce the window left before auto-compaction.
token_use: Lower value caps per-turn output spend; can truncate long answers.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT
what: Set to 1 so native-1M models (Sonnet 5, Fable, Haiku 5.5, Opus 4.7+) compact at 200K instead of about 967K by default.
token_use: Keeps every turn under 200K input, the point where Haiku 5.5 prompt cost rises.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL
what: Prompt cache TTL for the main conversation: 5m or 1h. Takes precedence over promptCacheTtl and ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H. 1-hour writes are billed higher.
token_use: Longer TTL avoids full re-reads after idle gaps; 5m is cheaper per write. Pick by how often you pause.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES
what: Minutes background work can keep an active goal waiting before Claude is asked to check on it. Default 30; 0 turns idle check-ins off; max 10080.
token_use: Setting 0 stops idle check-in turns that re-send the full context while you are away.

name: crossSessionInbound (setting)
what: Set to hold to keep messages from other sessions queued instead of delivered as new turns to an idle session.
token_use: Stops idle sessions from waking and re-sending full context on cross-session messages.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
what: Model used for background work (conversation summarization for --resume, command processing). Background spend is typically under $0.04 per session.
token_use: Chooses the cheap model for background calls.

name: Subagent model default (model field; CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL)
what: Subagents inherit the main session model unless a model field is set in the subagent definition (use model: haiku for simple tasks). CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL is named as the default for subagents and teammates; its precedence against the model field was not confirmed on the page read.
token_use: Routing simple subagent work to Haiku is the largest single lever on subagent spend.

name: statusLine (stdin JSON)
what: Script receives JSON on stdin. Documented paths: context_window.used_percentage, context_window.remaining_percentage, context_window.context_window_size, context_window.current_usage (input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens), cost.total_cost_usd, cost.total_duration_ms, cost.total_lines_added, exceeds_200k_tokens, rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage, rate_limits.seven_day, prompt_cache object, session_id, transcript_path, effort, fast_mode.
token_use: Continuous per-turn view of context fill, cost and cache state; read-only, costs no model tokens.

name: modelPricing (managed setting)
what: Managed-only table (multiplier and per-model overrides) so /usage, the statusline cost and OTEL cost match contracted rates. Ignored in user, project and local settings.
token_use: Does not change tokens; makes the cost figure honest for a team.

name: idleCompaction (setting)
what: "idleCompaction": false in settings.json turns off idle compaction in the terminal (from the changelog; not confirmed on the docs page).
token_use: Turning it off leaves a large idle context to be re-read at the next prompt.

name: fallbackModel (setting)
what: Fallback chain for subagent requests that fail over, from v2.1.247. Session model unchanged.
token_use: Failures do not re-run on the expensive model silently.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY
what: Required switch for OpenTelemetry export. Then set OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER (otlp, prometheus, console, none), OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL. Metrics export every 60 s; logs every 5 s.
token_use: Read-only export of every token and cost number Claude Code computes.

name: claude_code.token.usage
what: Metric in tokens. Attribute type: input, output, cacheRead, cacheCreation; also model, query_source, speed, effort, and attribution fields agent.name, skill.name, plugin.name, mcp_server.name, mcp_tool.name.
token_use: Per-model, per-skill and per-MCP-server token breakdown in your own dashboard.

name: claude_code.cost.usage
what: Metric in USD, attributes model, query_source, speed, effort. Computed at list price unless modelPricing applies.
token_use: Cost trend per model and per source.

name: claude_code.api_request (event)
what: Log event per API call with model, cost_usd, duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, request_id, query_source.
token_use: Per-request accounting; find the calls where cache reads fall off.

name: claude_code.tool_result (event)
what: Log event per tool call with tool_name, success, duration_ms, tool_input_size_bytes, tool_result_size_bytes. tool_input and tool_parameters only with OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1.
token_use: Shows which tools return the largest results, the first place to cut output.

name: claude_code.session.count
what: Metric counting sessions, attribute start_type: fresh, resume, continue, agents_view.
token_use: Shows how often sessions are resumed (resume means a full cache rebuild risk).

name: /usage
what: Session block: token counts by model, total cost (list price unless modelPricing), and a Prompt cache line (hit share, misses, expected rebuilds, warm or cold). Plan view adds attribution by skill, subagent, plugin and MCP server, and behavior flags at 10% or more. Press d or w for 24h or 7d.
token_use: Watch: shows where plan usage goes and cache misses.

name: /context
what: Shows what is consuming the context window, including deferred MCP tool listings.
token_use: Watch: find the MCP server or CLAUDE.md block that costs most before a turn.

name: /compact [instructions]
what: Summarizes the conversation now, with optional focus text (for example /compact Focus on test output). Also reads CLAUDE.md compact instructions.
token_use: Shrinks context, but the compaction itself is a large request that re-reads the whole conversation.

name: /clear
what: Starts a fresh session with no context. Resets the /usage session totals.
token_use: Costs nothing; stops every later turn from re-reading stale context.

name: /autocompact <value>
what: Sets the auto-compact window for the current model and later sessions, saved under modelSettings. Accepts 100k to 1M, or auto to use the tuned value.
token_use: Per-model version of the window cut.

name: /effort and /model
what: /effort lowers thinking effort for simpler tasks; /model switches model, and inheriting subagents follow the switch.
token_use: Biggest lever on output and thinking spend per turn; switch before delegating.

name: /cost
what: Named in the request; NOT confirmed on the costs page read. The costs page documents /usage (Session block) as the cost view.
token_use: Unverified; use /usage.

name: Prompt suggestions off
what: Turns off the background request that suggests your next prompt after each response (mostly cache reads plus a few output tokens).
token_use: Removes a small background request per turn.
